about.heading: About VORTEXSOFT VIKASDHARA FOUNDATION
about.copy:
VORTEXSOFT VIKASDHARA FOUNDATION is a public charitable trust established with a vision of contributing to education, skills, employment, humanitarian support, care and sustainable community development.

The Foundation aims to build practical programmes and partnerships that respond to community needs while maintaining accountability, dignity and responsible use of resources.

Our long-term vision is to grow from local initiatives into a broader platform for opportunity and social development across India.

vision.heading: Our Vision
vision.statement: To contribute to an India where people have greater access to education, skills, livelihood opportunities, care, dignity and community development resources.

mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.statement: To develop and support practical charitable programmes that create education, skill, employment, livelihood, humanitarian, environmental, animal-welfare and community-development opportunities for people and communities in need.

values.title: Opportunity
values.description: We focus on creating pathways rather than only temporary assistance.

values.title: Inclusion
values.description: Our programmes should serve people without discrimination.

values.title: Integrity
values.description: Resources should be handled responsibly and transparently.

values.title: Sustainability
values.description: We seek solutions that create lasting value.
